title: Script GC thread traversal
summary: Recover the collector's thread traversal at 0x4f1540, including value marking decisions, inclusive frame limits, stack tag clearing and conditional buffer shrinking. The VM marking, allocation, size error and pointer relocation operations remain explicit services.
test_description: Compare the original and source on live stack and inclusive frame ranges, frame and stack capacity thresholds, allocation sizes, state and buffer side effects, allocator accounting and untouched bytes, using an in-place allocator. Marking tests use simple object types handled by the accepted marker and compare object and collector bytes.
known_limits: Marking is delegated to the original VM service; complex object types and its external dispatch table are not exercised.
Allocation failure and oversized allocation error paths are delegated and not tested. Stack relocation is tested in place only.
The implementation assumes valid 32-bit VM addresses and bounded, well-formed stack and frame ranges.
